title: Unique Greek Sirloin Steak Skewers
description: A fresh and festive Greek dish featuring sirloin steak, tempered chocolate, and low sodium ingredients, perfect for a special occasion. This dish is sure to impress with its shattering flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano.
Add the sirloin steak cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated steak cubes onto the soaked wooden skewers.
Season the skewers with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Melt the tempered chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10 second increments, stirring between each interval.
Serve the grilled skewers with a drizzle of melted chocolate.
Garnish with fresh parsley or oregano, if desired.
